web.case.scope: For public software case validation; not a physical measurement or hardware safety certification.
web.case.evidence: Public software Provider bound to the registered case; not automatically evidence from physical hardware.
web.case.cannot.global: Global stability outside the measured operating region
web.case.cannot.performance: Control performance outside the declared conditions
web.case.dc_motor_speed_v1.title: 01 | DC motor speed: armature voltage → shaft angular velocity
web.case.dc_motor_speed_v1.goal: Test whether voltage–speed data provide the control features needed for a stable self-regulating plant.
web.case.tclab_single_heater_v1.title: 02 | Single-heater temperature: power change → temperature rise
web.case.tclab_single_heater_v1.goal: Test how time scales from conduction, convection, and sensor lag affect the initial controller candidate and bandwidth.
web.case.dc_motor_position_v1.title: 03 | DC motor position: armature voltage → shaft angle
web.case.dc_motor_position_v1.goal: Use the same actuator as the speed case, but measure position, to examine how the task and measured output affect diagnosis.
web.case.quadruple_tank_nmp_v1.title: 04 | Four-tank channel: pump voltage change → lower-tank level change
web.case.quadruple_tank_nmp_v1.goal: Use the adjustable-zero four-tank structure to test how external level data constrain inverse response and conservative control bandwidth.
web.case.tclab_dual_heater_v1.title: 05 | Dual-heater temperature: two power inputs → two temperature rises
web.case.tclab_dual_heater_v1.goal: Use paired static and frequency evidence to determine input–output pairing and initial multi-loop controllers for a thermally coupled system.
web.case.transition.goal: Enter the declared target regions in sequence and hold in the final region.
web.case.audit_class_i_level.title: Class I | Level channel: first-order self-regulation
web.case.audit_class_i_level.goal: Identify local static gain and the dominant time scale using repeated bounded steps.
web.case.audit_class_ii_thermal.title: Class II | Thermal channel: two lags and short delay
web.case.audit_class_ii_thermal.goal: Identify repeatable damping and time scales from bounded thermal responses.
web.case.audit_class_ii_oscillator.title: Class II | Flexible rig: underdamped oscillation
web.case.audit_class_ii_oscillator.goal: Estimate observable oscillation frequency and damping using bounded excitation.
web.case.audit_class_iii_motion.title: Class III | Low-friction platform: integrating motion
web.case.audit_class_iii_motion.goal: Distinguish finite static gain from local integrating motion using position records.
web.case.audit_class_iv_nmp.title: Class IV | External position: stable inverse response
web.case.audit_class_iv_nmp.goal: Identify inverse-response risk within the task bandwidth using external output measurements only.
web.case.audit_class_iv_high_order.title: Class IV | Multiple energy stores: stable higher-order dynamics
web.case.audit_class_iv_high_order.goal: Use public frequency and step evidence to assess the task-band limits of a low-order approximation.
web.case.audit_class_v_mimo.title: Class V | Two-variable process: dynamic coupling
web.case.audit_class_v_mimo.goal: Check static pairing and cross-coupling within the task bandwidth before using independent control loops.
